answer:
The company that was originally founded as **Sound of Music** is now known as **Best Buy**. 

Best Buy was added to the S&P 500 in **1999**.

The company was established by Richard M. Schulze and James Wheeler in 1966 under the name Sound of Music, later becoming Best Buy when they rebranded in 1983.
